channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: The most scenic trails in San Francisco, according to ‘walking influencers’
item.description: From short jaunts to epic city-crossing hikes, these are the eight best urban hikes in the city.

item.title: Brock Purdy and Mac Jones are the NFL’s best duo — so why should the 49ers break it up?
item.description: Purdy missed eight games in 2025, but San Francisco was able to stay afloat during his absence thanks to a backup with valuable experience.

item.title: Valkyries fans, SF businesses sweat the uncertainty of WNBA labor standoff
item.description: The players union and league have less than two weeks to reach terms before the 2026 season is affected.

item.title: War in Iran, crisis in AI: SF reacts to combat, divergent moves by Anthropic, OpenAI
item.description: As the Trump administration dropped bombs on Iran and banned Anthropic from defense contracts, Sam Altman said OpenAI would fall in line with government demands.

item.title: SF teachers ratify new contract — and their leader takes a victory lap
item.description: Union chief Cassondra Curiel is basking in her new power, and plotting how to use it next.

item.title: Analysis: Warriors secure Gui Santos on multi-year extension
item.description: Santos, 23, has been one of the brightest spots of the Warriors’ 2025-26 season

item.title: A photographer’s intimate portraits of their partner’s transitioning body
item.description: In the Wide Shot, Kirby Stenger takes us behind the scenes of their most personal portrait series yet.

item.title: 5 most anticipated SF restaurants opening in March
item.description: The city will get an injection of glamour when JouJou and The Big Four make their long-awaited debuts.

item.title: San Francisco’s milkshake-fueled diner revival, served with a side of nostalgia
item.description: A kitschy trio — Goldenette, Chicken Fried Palace, and Hamburguesa Bar — is scratching the city’s itch for vinyl booths and a retro aesthetic.

item.title: The Warriors gambled on a Steph Curry-Kristaps Porzingis pairing. So far, it’s a flop
item.description: Golden State’s superstar will miss at least five more games with runner’s knee, and its top trade deadline acquisition has only appeared in one game.
